categories.main_business_segments: Matrix Design Co., Ltd. primarily operates in space design and soft decoration services, focusing on residential real estate spaces such as sales offices and model rooms. It also serves non-residential sectors including office buildings, hotels, commercial spaces, and healthcare facilities. The company offers comprehensive design services from conceptual design to construction drawing and on-site coordination, alongside soft furnishing and decoration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including AI-driven design platforms (AIGC), BIM (Building Information Modeling), and intelligent optimization systems for construction drawings. It emphasizes digital transformation and smart design solutions, integrating AI for enhanced design efficiency and quality. The production process includes concept design, deepening design, construction drawing, and on-site construction cooperation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large and medium-sized real estate developers in the residential sector, including top-tier firms like China Resources Land, China Railway Construction, and Longfor Group. In the non-residential sector, clients include corporate headquarters, healthcare communities, commercial complexes, and hotels. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and has begun expanding into overseas markets such as Vietnam.
categories.geographic_coverage: Matrix Design operates primarily in China with design centers in Shenzhen (headquarters), Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, and branches in Xi'an, Wuhan, Hong Kong, and other cities. Its revenue is mainly derived from regions including East China, South China, Southwest China, North China, Northwest China, and Central China, with growing contributions from Southwest, Northwest, and Central regions. Overseas revenue is minimal but present.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates downstream in the real estate and construction supply chain, providing design and soft furnishing services to real estate developers and corporate clients. It does not engage in upstream material production but focuses on creative and technical design services and project execution support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company prioritizes innovation in AI-driven design, digital transformation, and smart design platforms to enhance efficiency and quality. It invests significantly in R&D projects related to AI-generated design methods, BIM optimization, intelligent parsing of architectural drawings, and data asset management. Talent development and retention, as well as expanding non-residential business sectors, are also key strategic focuses.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through fees for space design and soft decoration services, including staged payments aligned with project milestones. The company also earns income from sales of decorative products and photography services. It operates through bidding and direct commission models, with contracts signed upon project award or direct client engagement.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Matrix Design is positioned as a leading domestic design firm in China, ranked among the top global design companies by 'Interior Design' magazine, often leading in residential design. It competes with both domestic and international design firms, with a growing trend of domestic companies replacing foreign firms in mid-to-high-end markets. The company maintains strong brand recognition and long-term relationships with top real estate developers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 530 million, with net profit attributable to shareholders around RMB 33.7 million, showing stable performance despite a challenging real estate market. Total assets were about RMB 2.08 billion, with a slight year-on-year growth. The company’s R&D investment was nearly RMB 30 million, representing over 5% of revenue, indicating a commitment to innovation. Cash flow from operations remained positive but slightly declined compared to the previous year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Matrix Design emphasizes innovative and original design creativity as its core competitive advantage, delivering high-quality, culturally resonant, and technologically advanced space design and soft decoration solutions. Its integration of AI and digital technologies enables personalized, efficient, and high-standard design services. The company’s strong brand, extensive client base, and comprehensive service network provide differentiated value through reliable, creative, and full-cycle design capabilities.
